name: MLflow
one_liner: Open source platform for tracking experiments and managing models.
what_it_is: An open source platform covering agents, LLM applications and ML models, described by its maintainers as vendor-neutral. It records runs with their parameters, metrics and artefacts, and keeps versioned models in a registry that deployment can read from.
why_it_matters: Untracked experiments are the reason a result cannot be reproduced two months later: the number is in a notebook and the configuration that produced it is gone. Recording runs is the cheapest thing that makes work auditable, and a registry gives deployment something to point at other than a file on somebody laptop.
suitable_for: Teams who need to reproduce a result months later
Self-hosting, where the tracking server is yours to run
not_suitable_for: One-off analyses that will never be revisited
Teams unwilling to operate a tracking server and its storage
Work where the bottleneck is data quality rather than run bookkeeping
